candidate_program.name: bounded_neighbor_packing_pressure
candidate_program.rationale: Penalizes feasible rival packing beyond the strongest individual rival while preserving reward per conflict as the main signal. Reach is restricted to active neighbors; greedy packing and the maximum scan are paid per scored root and may dominate CPU.

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
